Z-score of 5.69 indicates statistically significant anomaly

themes_detail.label: Overgrown Tree and Branch Hazards

reporting_angles: Follow up with NYC Parks on tree inspection and maintenance backlog in Astoria/LIC. Is there a resource crunch?
Document specific problem locations: which blocks have hazardous overhanging branches? Talk to residents about safety concerns.

Z-score of 4.78 indicates high statistical significance
Spike occurred last week; sustained pattern worth monitoring for recurrence
reporting_angles: Map noise hotspots: Are complaints concentrated near construction sites, bars, or residential buildings? Interview affected residents.
Check NYPD noise enforcement logs for the same week—is enforcement lagging behind complaints?
